text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The opposition Renamo party failed on Tuesday to block clauses in a government bill establishing the right of municipal councils -- to be elected this year for the first time -- to levy taxes.
- The recently created Catholic University in Beira city will offer courses leading to masters degrees from next year. At present none of Mozambique's five universities confer post-graduate degrees.
